New daysWhat a brand-new day starts with
Fill and edit this dayFill the empty boxes, or clear several at once

All three fill the empty hook and driver boxes on this day. They never overwrite a box that already has something in it. They differ in where the answer comes from:

Fill from regular drivers
Uses your Duties tab. Each duty's regular driver goes in the Driver box. If they are off today (rest day, sick, AL) a free substitute from the Drivers tab goes in the Substitute box. Anyone with a regular van gets it in the Hook box if it is free. You see the list first and tick what to fill. The official plan.
Fill from usual
Uses history. For each duty it picks the person who most often did it over past weeks, following the rota patterns, and the van they most often took. It ignores the Duties tab. Drivers who are off are still suggested, with their badge, and you choose which rows to accept. What tends to happen.
Import from previous day
No working out. You pick one earlier day and it copies the hooks, drivers and substitutes exactly as they were. You choose what to bring over and can come back for more. A straight copy of one day.

The New days copy yesterday's hooks and drivers: yes setting above is the automatic form of Import: a plain copy of the last day with allocations, nothing cleverer.

What does each option do?
Arrange buttons
Move these buttons around and add dividers, so they sit the way you like.
Van details button (i)
Shows or hides the small i next to each hook. It opens that van's details.
Hook suggestions box
The box under the hook that shows a driver's usual van and how many times they have used it, for example Driver: 73 5×. Tap it to use that van. Press to show or hide it.
Office vans line
The list of this office's vans at the top of the sheet. Press to show it, show it without the vans that aren't on the office's list, or hide it.
Name style
Shows driver and substitute names in full, as J. SMITH, as JOHN S., or by their alias (set in the driver's details; anyone without one shows in full). Press to move to the next style.
Driver and substitute name boldness
How bold the driver names and the substitute names are on W2 to W12.
Driver history button (i)
Shows or hides the small i next to each driver. It shows the vans they have used.
Clear (×) button
The × next to a driver or substitute that clears the name (tap it 3 times). Show it always, only when the mouse is over the row, or not at all.
Show beside names
Photo, gender, L, height and more next to each driver's name. Tick the ones you want.
Suggested drivers
What appears in an empty driver box: suggestion buttons, a drop-down list, or nothing.
Suggested substitutes
Suggested substitutes as a drop-down list, as buttons, or not shown.
“Covered” note
The line under a substitute, for example Covered AHMED 5×. Show it under the name, only inside the info button, or hide it.
Substitute's own van
When a row has a substitute, also suggest the van that substitute uses most. Useful when the driver is on another duty.
Walk colours
Shows or hides the walk colours (Blue, Yellow, White, Pink, N/A) in the Duty and Partner boxes.
Text size, Letter spacing, Row height, Fit columns
Make the tables bigger or smaller, bring the letters closer together or further apart, make the rows taller or shorter, or fit every column to its longest entry.
New days copy yesterday's hooks and drivers
When you open a date for the first time. Press to go round three settings. Hooks and drivers: both are copied over. Drivers only: the drivers are copied and the hook boxes start empty. No: those boxes start empty, ready for Fill from regular drivers, Fill from usual or Import from previous day. Days you have already opened keep what they have. The difference: copying is a plain copy of the last day that has allocations, whoever was in each box that day, including one-off cover. It does not look at the regular drivers or the rota. Fill from regular drivers uses the Duties tab, and Fill from usual picks the most likely person and van from past weeks.
Fill from regular drivers
Puts each duty's regular driver (Duties tab) into the empty driver boxes, with a free substitute for anyone off today. You check the list first.
Fill from usual
Fills the empty hook and driver boxes with whoever normally does each duty and their usual van, worked out from past weeks.
Import from previous day
Copies the hooks, drivers and substitutes exactly as they were on an earlier day you pick.
Apply to all offices (fill buttons)
Tick it and the Fill from regular drivers, Fill from usual and Import from previous day lists open with their own Apply to all offices box already ticked, so one Fill does every office. You can still untick it in the list.
Move rows / columns / drivers
Move rows up or down, columns left or right, and drag drivers between rows.
Select to clear
Highlight hooks, drivers or substitutes, then clear them all at once.
Tap to see rest days this week and next week

History

How the history works

Newest at the top. The blue one is where you are now. Click any change to go back to just after it — everything after it is undone too. Press ↶ on the right of a change to undo just that one and keep everything you have done since. Changes above the blue one are undone and shown crossed out: click one to bring it back. Making a new change clears the crossed-out ones. This list is kept when you close the window, and goes up to GitHub with the data, so it is the same on every PC, browser and phone. Press 🔖 on a change to stop undo going back past it — press it again to take it off. Use Sort and What changed just below to group the list, or to tick off kinds of change you are not looking for.
